verdicts.evidence: Under "When the boats run", the copy says the ferry leaves every forty minutes between early morning and late evening and that the last crossing leaves before dusk, and it gives no clock times.

The two large headings are in a brush script; the subtitle, the section headings and the card text are in a serif; the nav, the main body text and the button are in a sans, so body text appears in two faces at two sizes.
The image shows many close sizes: the serif subtitle is only slightly smaller than the serif section headings, and the card body is only slightly larger than the main body text.
